label: screening
tipNote: Material purchased-power break-even; solo-sale; PV CAPEX stripped.

method.flipMetric: annualNetCash = R − OPEX − annualized CAPEX (Foundry gate)
method.powerModel: Purchased: electricity-source/power/electricity unitCost=p $/kWh; clear installedCapex/capexRate/fixedOM (no PV+grid double-count). Process CAPEX/OPEX and TEA sale prices retained.
method.soloSale: Solo-sale: only material sinks keep bindSale unitPrice; other sale sinks unitPrice=0.
method.sizing: sizeForPositiveCashflow FAST scales=[1] rates=[0]; freeze then econ-only sweep
method.heroPick: Max material tonnes among cash+ abundance sites (hunt multi-product cash); else max tonnes overall. Shared mode uses that same hero, then scores cash with full co-product revenue.

caveats: Solo-sale zeros co-product revenue: flip points are product-specific, not co-product contribution-margin aliases. A material that only pencils with co-products will show no-flip / always-negative.
Baseline abundance is PV-CAPEX powered; this sensitivity replaces PV TIC/fixedOM with a purchased $/kWh so power cost is not double-counted.
Prices are cited tea-screening bindSale mid bands by site region — screening offtake, not contracts or vendor quotes.
Hero scale is the multi-product cash maximizer size, frozen before solo-sale; not re-optimized for the single product.

rows.notes: Hero: max lithium tonnes among cash+ sites → 342.57 t/y. PV multi-product baseline cash $4619095/y (cash+). Sized selected={"family":"abundance","slateMode":"minerals-only","scale":1}; freeze capacities then solo-sale (other sale prices zeroed) + purchased-power econ-only. flip

Hero: max bromine tonnes among cash+ sites → 137.97 t/y. PV multi-product baseline cash $136216/y (cash+). Sized selected={"family":"abundance","slateMode":"full","scale":1}; freeze capacities then solo-sale (other sale prices zeroed) + purchased-power econ-only. Solo-sale annualNetCash ≤ 0 even at p=0 (purchased power free); process CAPEX/OPEX alone dominates TEA revenue for this material at the frozen hero scale.
